scientific.integrity: The counterexample is proved by a pulse-to-pulse comparison in the printed model. The primary PDF was inspected at the model, boundedness lemma, boundary periodic orbit, Floquet theorem, permanence theorem and its proof. The bundled checker replays theorem hypotheses and arithmetic only; no simulation is used as proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result gives a necessary pulse-survival condition and a counterexample to the published sufficient theorem. It does not provide a complete corrected sufficient criterion for permanence and does not dispute the source's separate numerical examples.

title: A pulse-survival obstruction refutes the published permanence theorem for an impulsive mackerel model
